hints: There are multiple queries but only n<=500 cities, so precompute every pair's shortest distance.
Initialize direct road costs and zero on the diagonal; keep the minimum if parallel roads exist.
For each possible intermediate city k, allow routes from i to j that go through k.
analogy: Gradually permit each city to serve as a transfer stop and improve all pairs of routes.
example: If i->k costs 4 and k->j costs 5, the route through k updates i->j to at most 9.
algorithm: Use Floyd-Warshall: for k,i,j, set dist[i][j]=min(dist[i][j],dist[i][k]+dist[k][j]); answer each query or -1 if unreachable.
correctness: After processing k, dist[i][j] is the best route whose intermediate cities come from the processed set; induction over k proves all routes considered at the end.
